model.title: Promoting Resilient Buildings Act
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee · Sen. John Cornyn (R-TX)

summary.text: The bill would make it easier for federal disaster relief funds to support building code improvements by allowing use of either the current or previous edition of building codes. It would prohibit a federal loan program from funding building code activities and establish a new pilot program through 2030 to provide grants for homeowners to retrofit their residences against natural hazards, prioritizing those with financial need.
